notes.title: V1.0.4版本更新说明
notes.content:
[h3]中文：[/h3]
1. 修复问题：解决了不同分辨率下无法框选地块的情况。  
2. 新增功能：宝箱界面支持直接输入金币数量，操作更加便捷。  
3. 优化模式解锁条件：自由模式解锁条件下调，只需通过挑战模式或困难模式中的任意关卡即可开启。  

[h3]游戏操作指南：[/h3]
[b]相机操作[/b]
WASD键：移动相机（W上、S下、A左、D右）
鼠标中键长按拖动：平移相机
空格键：相机重置到居中位置
鼠标中键滚动：调整视野缩放

[b]地块操作[/b]
长按鼠标左键拖动：框选多个地块
框选地块后鼠标右键：呼出操作菜单
Ctrl + A：快速框选所有地块
Ctrl + 鼠标左键单击：添加单个地块到选中区域
鼠标左键单击空白处：取消选中所有地块

[h3]English:[/h3]
Bug Fixes: Resolved the issue where tile selection failed at different resolutions.
New Feature: Added the ability to directly input coin amounts on the treasure chest interface for improved convenience.
Mode Unlock Optimization: Lowered the unlock requirements for Free Mode; it can now be accessed by completing any level in Challenge Mode or Hard Mode.

[h3]Game Controls Guide:[/h3]
[b]Camera Controls[/b]
WASD Keys: Move the camera (W: Up, S: Down, A: Left, D: Right)
Hold and Drag Middle Mouse Button: Pan the camera
Spacebar: Reset the camera to the center position
Scroll Mouse Wheel: Adjust the zoom level

[b]Tile Controls[/b]
Hold down the left mouse button and drag: Select multiple tiles
Right-click after selecting tiles: Open the action menu
Ctrl + A: Quickly select all tiles
Ctrl + Left-click: Add a single tile to the selection
Left-click on an empty area: Deselect all tiles

notes.title: 11月20日更新说明（November 20th Update Notes）
notes.content:
[b]中文[/b]
1. 修复动物繁殖期状态无法触发任务的问题。

[b]English[/b]

2. Increase the resource rewards for late-game tasks.

notes.title: 1.0.2版本更新（Version 1.0.2 Update）
notes.content:
[b]中文：[/b]
1、修复了农民无法收割与储水池相邻地块成熟作物的问题。
2、修复了通过其他工具收获成熟植物时，未触发储水池相邻地块浇水的问题。
3、下调了困难模式中的游戏难度。

[b]English[/b]
1、Fixed the issue where farmers could not harvest crops when the farmland was adjacent to a water reservoir.
2、Fixed the issue where mature plants harvested using other tools did not trigger watering for farmland 
3、adjacent to a water reservoir.
Reduced the game difficulty in hard mode.

notes.title: 11月16更新说明（November 16 Update Notes）
notes.content:
1、优化钓鱼系统体验，增加判定范围，将钓鱼时长从3秒延长至4秒。
Optimize the fishing system experience by increasing the detection range and extending the fishing duration from 3 seconds to 4 seconds.
